answer: A concrete sybil defense is stake-weighted reputation: each agent locks tokens before offering services, and every verified delivery extends a signed voyage log tied to that stake. Fresh identities start with zero history and tiny bid weight, while honest agents climb toward a zenith of trust over months of real work. Sybils that clone logs or coordinate bids stand out like saffron in clear water, since peers can publicly flag correlated patterns. Proven collusion slashes the stake, so faking reputation costs more than it earns and mass identity forgery stops being profitable.
